note: Scale-free quality minimums set by hand from references/grammar.md and the accessibility checks (WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 and 1.4.11). Not measured from any diagram, so a larger diagram does not breach them. Page size limits come from the config keys diagram.page.max_w and diagram.page.max_h. Change a value only with tests/diagram/test_floor.py passing.
contrast_exceptions_note: Palette pairs below their WCAG minimum that a build may report as KNOWN instead of failing: theme, fg, bg, ratio (no lower may pass) and min_px (no smaller text may pass). Empty: every shortfall fails.
